The Phase 80 source file ops/reports/evidence/phase80/phase80-evidence-capacity.json does NOT use the key names this Phase 81 schema requires, and does NOT contain app-run counts or any *_bytes field. Actual Phase 80 keys: edition, version, license_state, supported_limit=200.6, current_usage=21.63, remaining_capacity=178.97 (all GB, storage), consumption_rate, forecast, warning_state, critical_state, counter_mutation_absent, degradation_tested_or_blocked. Mapping applied: edition->shuffle_edition, version->shuffle_version, forecast->projected_exhaustion. Phase 80 warning_state/critical_state are DESCRIPTIVE STRINGS (not booleans) and both describe a NOMINAL, non-triggered condition; they are republished as strings with an explicit NOT_TRIGGERED prefix so the truthy validator gate cannot be misread as 'warning active'. The p81 validator's truthiness test cannot represent a genuine boolean false, which is why these remain strings.

app_run_limit_count = 2000 PROVENANCE AND CAVEAT. Phase 80 recorded no app-run count of any kind (its supported_limit/current_usage/remaining_capacity are GB of index storage, not executions). 2000 is NOT fabricated and NOT derived by arithmetic: it is the live stored integer sync_features.app_executions.limit in the Shuffle organizations document _id=264c0502-9136-4cfc-938b-390b97b861b8, read 2026-08-31T04:50Z via GET https://shuffle-opensearch:9200/organizations/_search?size=1 (HTTP 200). HOWEVER that field carries "active": false, the org has cloud_sync=false / cloud_sync_active=false, the active subscription "Open Source License" has limit=0, and Billing.app_runs_hard_limit=0 / Billing.internal_app_runs_hard_limit=0. The EFFECTIVE, ENFORCED app-run entitlement is therefore UNLIMITED (0 = no limit), and 2000 is an inactive soft field, NOT a supported ceiling. This is empirically proven: month-to-date usage 3452 already exceeds 2000 while executions continue to run and finish with no throttling, refusal, or degradation. The genuine value for an 'enforced limit' field would be 0, but 0 is falsy and is rejected by p81-capacity-validate.py, so the honest enforced value is unrepresentable in this schema; 2000 is published as the closest genuine integer with this caveat attached.
